summary: This RFC defines an XML-based data model for conference objects in centralized conferencing (XCON), which RFC 5239 describes as participants associated with a central focus. The model carries information about a conference and about who takes part in it. Other XCON protocols build on it.

eli5.summary: A conference call needs a list of what the meeting is and who is in it. This is a standard form for that list, so different programs can fill it in and read it the same way.
